data.name: Naseehat
data.gender_notes: Naseehat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who gives advice or counsel, or the act of giving such advice or counsel. The name Naseehat carries the meaning “Advice, Counsel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Naseehat usually hope their child will grow to embody advice, counsel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Seeking and giving guidance and advice from a wise and knowledgeable person to help navigate through life's challenges and make the right decisions.
data.etymology: Naseehat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Advice, Counsel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naseehat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: نصيحة
in_arabic.meaning: كلمة تعبر عن النصيحة أو الإرشاد للخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'نَصَحَ' الذي يعني الإخلاص والإرشاد للخير. يستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الارشاد أو النصيحة الصادقة التي توجه الفرد نحو الصواب والخير. يعتبر من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل والسامي في التراث العربي والإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: نصیحت
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسی بات جو کسی کو اچھائی یا فلاح کے لئے کہی جائے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نصیحت ایک عربی मूल کا اسم ہے، جو 'نَصَحَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خلوص اور بھلائی کی رہنمائی کرنا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا استعمال صادقانہ مشورے یا رہنمائی کے لئے ہوتا ہے جو فرد کو صحیح راستے اور بھلائی کی طرف لے جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقليد میں اچھے اور بلند معانی کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नसीहत
in_hindi.meaning: कोई बात जो अच्छे काम या भलाई के लिए कही जाती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नसीहत एक अरबी मूल का नाम है, जो 'नसह' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है सच्चाई और अच्छाई की ओर मार्गदर्शन करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग सच्ची सलाह या मार्गदर्शन के लिए होता है जो व्यक्ति को सही रास्ते और भलाई की ओर ले जाता है। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में सुंदर और उच्च अर्थों के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: نصیحت
in_pashto.meaning: دېر لارښوونه يا مشوره چې د چا لپاره ويل کېږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: نصیحت د عربي اصلي نوم دی، چې د 'نَصَحَ' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د خلوص او نیکۍ مشوره ورکول دي. په پښتني او افغان اسلامي کلتور کې د دې نوم استعمال داسې سچ مشوره یا لارښوونه ده چې کوم کس ته د سموالي او نیکۍ لارښوونه کوي. دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې د ښکلي او لوړ معني سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Naseehat
in_english.meaning: A word of advice or guidance for good
in_english.long_meaning: Naseehat is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'nasaḥa', which means to give sincere advice or guidance. In Islamic culture, it signifies honest counsel or direction towards righteousness and goodness. The name carries a rich history and spiritual significance, reflecting values of wisdom, compassion, and moral guidance. It is used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person who offers genuine and heartfelt advice.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naseehat carries a rich cultural significance as it is derived from the Arabic word "Naseehah," which means advice or counsel. In Muslim communities, the act of giving advice or counsel is considered a noble deed and a significant component of building strong interpersonal relationships. Naseehat is a reminder of the strong emphasis on community, respect, and wisdom within the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Naseehat holds great significance as giving and receiving advice and counsel is often seen as a means of seeking spiritual guidance and growth. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is reported to have said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity." (Bukhari and Muslim). In giving or receiving advice, individuals not only strengthen their relationships but also contribute to the spiritual development of others, creating a ripple effect of compassion, kindness, and growth. Additionally, seeking and following the guidance of religious scholars or spiritual mentors serves as a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual growth, submission to Allah, and following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) as outlined in the Quran and Sunnah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Advice, Counsel" symbolizes A person who gives advice or counsel, or the act of giving such advice or counsel.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Naseehat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of advice, counsel.
